Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 348.32 per unit (po:4500014474-10, po:4500014413-10, po:4500014350-20).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. However, we checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

We appreciate the updated volume forecast and agree to implement the CU-NOTATION index clause as requested. We can accept your terms and await your order. 

Our Angebot is valid for 30 days. It features a price of €361.82 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, and a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

decisions.tactician: o6 at health gives the supplier its strongest need, copper protection. It is worth an estimated +5 % to it versus its own sheet, so acceptance is likely, possibly even at once. Our C is €2,251,155, about €32k below C_open. The clause-free o1 health has a lower C (€2,233k) but is -3.3 % to the supplier, which needs approval cycles and risks a slow grind. Still, o6 is close to o1 and has a far better chance of being accepted. E0 at €348.32 sits below the supplier's cost, so it would bring the relationship charge and a refusal; its C of €2,270k is also worse. The db 5 % clause is the cheapest clause for us. I cite the volume rise and the order history as levers.

why.tactician: The standing sheet equals o6 at its health price, which is the lowest C of any option (€2,251,155). The other options, o7 and o8, cost us more because of their wider clause exposure. A lower price would fall below health and raise C through the relationship charge, and the supplier would need committee approval to go there. Every rung on our terms is at or above this price, so countering or holding gains nothing and risks the deal. Acceptance closes at our best C now.
